description: This file implements the RDKLoggerAgent class, providing functions for initializing, logging, and managing log levels for RDK modules. It includes detailed methods for creating, configuring, checking log statuses, and test utilities for logging at various levels, plus environment variable handling related to RDK logging.

classes.name: RDKBLoggerAgent
classes.description: This class serves as a wrapper for the RDK logger functions, enabling logging control, environment management, and test utilities within the RDK application framework.

methods.description: Initializes the logger agent, setting up environment for logging.

methods.description: Cleans up or resets prerequisites after test execution.
